_source: DST NIDHI-EIR national programme structure for Technology Business Incubators
name: DST NIDHI Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR)
provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India
oneLiner: Monthly fellowship and pre-incubation mentoring for student, doctoral, and postdoctoral innovators validating a deep-science venture.

atAGlance.purpose: Living fellowship and concept validation support while translating laboratory research into a venture
atAGlance.fundingAgency: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India
atAGlance.expectedOutput: Validated proof-of-concept, business model, and incorporation of a deep-tech startup
atAGlance.whoCanApply: Graduating BS-MS, BS, PhD, postdoctoral researchers, and engineering/science graduates committed full-time

benefits: Monthly fellowship grant of up to ₹30,000 per month for up to 12 months
Co-working desk at IICE and structured mentoring from IISER Bhopal faculty
eligibility: Citizen of India with a degree in science, engineering, medicine, or technology.
Committed full-time to pursuing an innovative technology business idea at IICE with no concurrent salary.
Supported by a Technical Evaluation Committee review at IICE, IISER Bhopal.
coveredUses: Monthly Entrepreneur-in-Residence fellowship support as per DST NIDHI norms.
Guided access to IICE co-working desks, E-Cell workshops, and faculty advisory sessions.
nonPermittedUses: Capital equipment purchases or international travel.

selectionSteps.label: Concept Submission
selectionSteps.detail: Submit a concept note and prototype roadmap through the IICE application portal.

selectionSteps.label: TEC Review
selectionSteps.detail: Evaluation of scientific novelty and founder commitment by the Technical Evaluation Committee.

beneficiaries.name: Protomate AI
beneficiaries.oneLiner: Multilingual conversational AI diagnostic assistant for early mental-health screening.
